# `returns`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Returned order items.

**Grain:** order item.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | Real order key. | text |
| `order_item_id` | Real item sequence. | integer |
| `return_date` | Day of the return. | date |
| `reason` | damaged, wrong_item, not_as_described, changed_mind or late_delivery. | text |
| `refund_value` | Amount refunded (the item price). | BRL |

## Join keys

- `(order_id, order_item_id) = order_items.(order_id, order_item_id)`

## Caveats

- Only delivered items are returned. Planted: E4 late-delivery returns in PR, SC and RS, 21 days after purchase.
